Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 542/2020

Dear Mr. Bose,

Thank you for meeting us on 13 November 2020 about your dispute with Saxena Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 21,90,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
